Amanitas and Worms
I at them raw and got worms.
I have eaten the Psilocybin variety many times before and never contracted worms, but with the Amanitas, I was less fortunate.  I believe this is because most psilo type mushroom are cultivated in clean man made environments, not from the ground.
The experiences from the Amanitas were pleasant but not very insightful.
Worms are a pain in the butt, no pun intended.  I took some prescription Vermox for a while, and followed up with clarkia (cloves, black walnut husks, and Wormwood tincture), and now I'm worm free.  So be careful out there.
